description: Create a top-up order and get a payment link. Nothing is charged by this call: a person must open payment_url and pay in cryptocurrency on NOWPayments. Delivery to the phone is automatic after the payment confirms. Before calling, confirm the phone number, operator, product and price with the person: delivered top-ups cannot be reversed. You may ask which coin they want to pay with (list_payment_coins) and pass it as pay_with; it is optional. amount and currency must match the product's price (or lie inside its price_range).

currency.description: Price currency from list_products, e.g. EUR

pay_with.description: Optional coin code from list_payment_coins, e.g. usdttrc20. The payment page then opens with that coin selected.

name: create_order
title: Create a top-up order (returns a payment link)
